scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @collabcode/server && npm run build -w @collabcode/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @collabcode/shared && npm run build -w @collabcode/agent && npm run build -w @collabcode/model-gateway
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,agent,gateway,server,web -c gray,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:agent" "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.evals: npm run build:shared && npm run evals -w @collabcode/evals --
scripts.evals:selftest: npm run build:shared && npm run selftest -w @collabcode/evals
